missions.fullAnalysis: Strategic focus: Nominative subject. 'Мгновение' is the nominative subject of the sentence. 'Прекрасное' is the agreeing neuter adjective. A clean model for describing a moment in time.
Strategic focus: Accusative direct object. 'Мгновение' is the accusative object of 'запомнил'; neuter inanimate nouns match the nominative. 'Это' agrees in the neuter accusative.
Strategic focus: Genitive after negation. 'Мгновения' is the genitive after the negated 'ни одного'. The soft-stem neuter takes '-я'. A vivid way to urge someone not to waste time.
Strategic focus: Dative with 'благодаря'. 'Мгновению' is the dative governed by 'благодаря'. 'Этому' is the agreeing neuter dative form. A natural cause-and-effect frame.
Strategic focus: Accusative of time. 'В мгновение' uses the accusative after 'в' to pinpoint a moment when something happens. 'Это' agrees in the neuter accusative. A common time marker.
Strategic focus: Instrumental case. 'Мгновением' is the instrumental expressing the means or instant by which things were decided. 'Одним' agrees in the neuter instrumental.
Strategic focus: Prepositional case. 'В мгновении' uses the prepositional 'мгновении' after 'в' to mark location in time. 'Каждом' is the agreeing neuter prepositional adjective.
Strategic focus: Nominative plural subject. 'Мгновения' is the nominative plural, the subject of 'пролетели'. 'Эти' is the agreeing plural form. Good for the neuter plural ending '-я'.
Strategic focus: Genitive plural. 'Мгновений' is the genitive plural required after 'много'; soft-stem neuters end in '-ий'. 'Счастливых' is the agreeing plural genitive adjective.
Strategic focus: Accusative of duration. 'Мгновение' is the accusative expressing a brief span of waiting. 'Одно' agrees in the neuter, and 'пожалуйста' softens the request.
